fullPassage: Marine plastic pollution is a complex problem that occurs on many levels, as it presents physical, chemical, and biological implications for marine compartments at small scales while involving vast geographic domains. To counteract what can be regarded as a planetary boundary threat, we need tailored instruments to provide various layers of knowledge in an accessible manner. To this end, laboratory experiments and observations are indeed fundamental to capture specific aspects of plastic and plastic-related pollution; yet this zoo of data is still insufficient to provide a holistic description of this pervasive phenomenon. Quantitative methods can link and exploit our current understanding of the different processes and complex interaction characterizing marine plastic pollution to ultimately help to shed some light on aspects that are hard to investigate in the field. Actions against marine pollution have to be timely, bold, and knowledge-based. In this perspective, comprehensive, data-informed approaches can help not only to identify and protect the mechanisms that interconnect marine ecosystems but also to understand the processes and synergies that are disrupting them.

det.korean: ③이 원문과 일치 — help to shed some light on aspects hard to investigate in the field

해양 오염에 대한 조치는 지식에 기반해야 한다.

questions.passage: ① Marine plastic pollution is a complex, multi-level problem with physical, chemical, and biological effects. ② Laboratory experiments alone are sufficient to fully describe this widespread phenomenon. ③ Quantitative methods can help illuminate aspects that are difficult to study in natural settings. ④ Comprehensive, data-informed approaches are needed to protect marine ecosystems.
questions.stem: 다음은 위 글의 내용을 요약한 것이다. ①~④ 중, 원문의 내용과 다르게 요약된 부분을 고르시오.

det.korean: ② 원문: insufficient(불충분) → 요약: sufficient(충분) — 의미 반대
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 S1과 일치: complex problem, physical/chemical/biological implications
❌ ② 원문: 'this zoo of data is still insufficient' → 요약: 'sufficient to fully describe'. insufficient(불충분)을 sufficient(충분)으로 바꿔 반대 의미 ←정답
✅ ③ 원문 S4와 일치: shed some light = illuminate, in the field = in natural settings
✅ ④ 원문 S6과 일치: comprehensive, data-informed approaches + protect marine ecosystems
det.tip: insufficient → sufficient: 핵심 형용사를 반대로 바꾼 것이 오류이다.

questions.passage: Marine plastic pollution is a complex problem that occurs on many levels, as it presents physical, chemical, and biological implications for marine compartments at small scales while involving vast geographic domains. To counteract what can be regarded as a planetary boundary threat, we need tailored instruments to provide various layers of knowledge in an accessible manner. To this end, laboratory experiments and observations are indeed fundamental to capture specific aspects of plastic and plastic-related pollution; yet this zoo of data is still insufficient to provide a holistic description of this pervasive phenomenon. Quantitative methods can link and exploit our current understanding of the different processes and complex interaction characterizing marine plastic pollution to ultimately help to shed some light on aspects that are hard to investigate in the field. Actions against marine pollution have to be timely, bold, and knowledge-based. In this perspective, comprehensive, data-informed approaches can help not only to identify and protect the mechanisms that interconnect marine ecosystems but also to understand the processes and synergies that are disrupting them.

det.tip: planetary boundary threat(지구적 경계 위협): 해양 오염이 지구 시스템의 한계를 위협하는 수준임을 의미.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 데이터 기반 종합 접근의 필요성
det.analysis:
❌ ① 화학적 성분은 부분적 언급이지 주제가 아님
❌ ② 실험실 한계는 논의의 일부이지 전체 주제가 아님
❌ ③ 국제 협약은 본문에 언급 없음
✅ ④ 본문 전체가 실험 데이터의 한계를 지적하고 정량적·포괄적·데이터 기반 접근의 필요성을 주장 ←정답
det.tip: comprehensive, data-informed approaches(포괄적, 데이터 기반 접근)가 글의 핵심 제안이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 정량적·포괄적 접근의 필요성이 요지
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문: 데이터가 '불충분(insufficient)' (충분하지 않음)
✅ ② 원문 핵심: 실험은 근본적이나 불충분 → 정량적 방법 + 포괄적 접근 필요 ←정답
❌ ③ 원문: 'vast geographic domains'(광대한 영역) + 'planetary boundary threat' (소규모 아님)
❌ ④ 원문에 자체 복원력 언급 없음. 오히려 생태계가 '붕괴(disrupting)' 중이라고 경고
det.tip: fundamental but insufficient → quantitative + comprehensive: 실험의 한계를 넘어선 종합 접근이 요지.

ch: 해양 오염은 실험실 연구만으로 충분히 이해할 수 있다.
실험 데이터의 한계를 보완하려면 정량적·포괄적 접근이 필요하다.
해양 플라스틱 오염은 소규모 지역 문제에 불과하다.
해양 생태계는 자체 복원력으로 오염을 극복할 수 있다.

questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 조건에 따라 빈칸에 영어로 쓰시오.

우리말: '다양한 지식 층위를 제공하기 위한 맞춤형 도구'

[조건] (1) instruments, knowledge, layers, of, provide, tailored, to, various를 모두 사용
(2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

보기: instruments / knowledge / layers / of / provide / tailored / to / various

det.korean: 다양한 지식 층위를 제공하기 위한 맞춤형 도구
det.analysis:
본문 S2: 'we need tailored instruments to provide various layers of knowledge in an accessible manner'의 핵심 목적어 + to부정사구.

구문: tailored instruments(맞춤형 도구) + to provide(제공하기 위한, 목적의 to부정사) + various layers of knowledge(다양한 지식 층위).

8단어: tailored(1) instruments(2) to(3) provide(4) various(5) layers(6) of(7) knowledge(8).
det.tip: tailored instruments to provide: to부정사가 목적(~하기 위한)을 나타내는 형용사적 용법이다.
